title: Pocket Poets
game_overview: A 2D literary verse-battler and deckbuilder featuring 20 legendary poets across 5 gated chapters, culminating in the Sovereign Triad showdown.
winning_condition: Conquer all progressive tiers and assemble your 25-poet Anthology.
losing_condition: Run out of Inspiration Points during a verse duel or fail to maintain the rhyme meter.

controls.action: Navigate player across the district map.
Talk to locals for location clues, inspect landmarks, or challenge wandering poets.
Select stanza lines and poetic counters during verse duels.
Mobile touch overlay for full movement and interaction.

sections.title: Progression & Chapter Gates
sections.content: Quest Mode organizes all 20 poets across 5 distinct Chapters with unlockable gates: Chapter I (4 poets: Robert Frost, Langston Hughes, Matsuo Basho, Maya Angelou), Chapter II (4 poets: Pablo Neruda, Li Bai, Walt Whitman, Emily Dickinson), Chapter III (4 poets: Edgar Allan Poe, Charles Baudelaire, Sylvia Plath, Sor Juana Ines de la Cruz), Chapter IV (5 poets: William Blake, Anna Akhmatova, Mahmoud Darwish, Rabindranath Tagore, Rumi), and Chapter V: The Sovereign Triad (3 poets: Sappho, William Shakespeare, Dante Alighieri). Total roster: exactly 20 poets.
sections.summary: 5-Chapter gated progression across exactly 20 historical poets culminating in the Sovereign Triad.
